lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertically aligned columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial slits, exhibiting a non-uniform grid distribution with wider horizontal spacing towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect with the circular spot rows to form a lattice-like geometric pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant aggregation of multiple small teleost fish (remoras) clustered primarily near the ventral-lateral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
